{"script":"set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
# 2. Recursively enumerate all filesystem entries under /working
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/all_paths.txt || true
# 3. Extract entries whose basename is exactly "workspace"
awk -F"/" 'NF{ if($NF=="workspace") print }' temp_workspace_check/all_paths.txt > temp_workspace_check/matching_paths.txt
# 4. For each matching path, record metadata (type, permissions, link target)
: > temp_workspace_check/matching_metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    stat -c '%n|%F|%A|%N' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s|error obtaining metadata\n' "$p"
  else
    printf '%s|missing\n' "$p"
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/matching_paths.txt > temp_workspace_check/matching_metadata.txt
# 5. Filter only entries identified as regular files
grep '|regular file|' temp_workspace_check/matching_metadata.txt > temp_workspace_check/regular_files.txt || true
# 6. Count lines in regular_files.txt
wc -l < temp_workspace_check/regular_files.txt > temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt || true
# 7. Record unexpected cases (not regular files)
grep -v '|regular file|' temp_workspace_check/matching_metadata.txt > temp_workspace_check/discrepancies.txt || true
# 8. Prune all_paths.txt of unrelated entries (keep only basename workspace) and consolidate manifest
cp temp_workspace_check/matching_paths.txt temp_workspace_check/pruned_all_paths.txt
: > temp_workspace_check/compact_manifest.txt
for f in matching_paths.txt matching_metadata.txt regular_files.txt regular_count.txt discrepancies.txt pruned_all_paths.txt; do
  if [ -e "temp_workspace_check/$f" ]; then
    stat -c '%n %s' "temp_workspace_check/$f" >> temp_workspace_check/compact_manifest.txt || true
  fi
done
# 9. Create marker file referencing regular_count.txt and indicating readiness (without emitting decision)
printf 'references: %s\ncondition: produce "yes" if the numeric count in %s is greater than zero, otherwise produce "no"\nready: true\n' "temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt" "temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt" > temp_workspace_check/result_ready.txt
# Final: output yes/no depending on whether a regular file named "workspace" exists
count=$(cat temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "${count}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
